messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High rate of GPU attach failures observed in asia-south2 — autoscaler retry loop, scale-up not completing. Investigate.
oncall-eng: On it, joining bridge in 2m. Any immediate customer impact flags?
alice: Seeing queue growth for embeddings and batch inference routes, tail latency rising. ~15% of pods stuck Pending.
ben: I can repro one attach error from logs: `googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded for region 'asia-south2'` — looks like regional quota hit, not node image issue.
carol: Confirmed. Autoscaler keeps creating node requests but GCP returns quota-denied. Attach error snapshot: ```
I0317 12:03:02.123 kubelet.go:234] FailedAttachVolume for pvc-abc123: googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded
pods: Pending 12, Running 140, Failed 0
Autoscaler: created 8 nodes, 6 failed to attach GPUs
```
oncall-eng: Customer-facing routes impacted: embeddings (high) and rerank — estimated 7% 5xxs, retries spiking. Posting incident channel for visibility. :warning:
sre-lead: If quota is the root cause, we need two mitigations: 1) emergency cross-region fallback routing for critical traffic, 2) reduce GPU request sizes / fallback instances for non-critical background jobs. Who can open quota request with GCP immediately?
alice: I already filed a quota increase ticket 36h ago, still pending. I can escalate but not guaranteed. GCP support shows 'pending manual review'.
ben: For quick mitigation I can flip routing for embeddings to us-west2 warm pool (smaller models) — will increase latency but keep success rate. Anyone object?
carol: Do it. Also enable reduced_batch_size feature flag for background batch jobs to free up capacity.
oncall-eng: Executing reroute now: `PATCH /config/routing` -> set embeddings to fallback-us-west2 for 20% of traffic, critical=100% if failures continue.
support-bot: Customer impact note: Some customers in APAC report timeouts for batch embeddings; initiating proactive CS emails for top-10 customers.
sre-lead: Can someone run a quick capacity audit and list which projects/quotas are exhausted (GPU accelerators, vCPUs tied to accelerator quota, regional attach limits)?
ben: Pulling quota list... ```
gcloud compute regions describe asia-south2 --format=json | jq .quotas | grep GPUs -A2
"name": "GPUS", "limit": 48, "usage": 48
"name": "GPUs_NVIDIA_T4", "limit": 32, "usage": 32
```
ben: So T4/VCores quotas at ceiling.
alice: Ops idea: enable CPU-only fallback for low-priority queues and cancel enqueuing of large background batches for 30m. That should reduce pending pods by ~8-10.
carol: I'm toggling job enqueues off for non-critical pipeline now.
oncall-eng: Patch applied: job_enqueue=false for pipeline-background. Observed Pending pods drop from 12 -> 5 in last 3m.
sre-lead: Good. Still need sustainable fix — consider temporary reconfiguration to request g4dn (AWS) via multi-cloud routing if quota not available. Any concerns about data locality / compliance?
alice: A few customers require APAC-only serving; for those we need to maintain within region. For others, multi-region fallback is OK.
ben: Created short-lived manual change to route non-APAC traffic to aws-us-west2-g4 instances. Rolling out as canary at 10%.
support-bot: Pinged CS for customers with APAC restriction to confirm tolerance for degraded perf. Two customers flagged 'must remain APAC' — we'll keep them queued on best-effort and notify.
carol: FYI autoscaler logs show repeated retry with exponential backoff: `scaleUp: failed -> retry in 30s, attempt 7` — until quota freed, autoscaler will loop. Need to avoid runaway creation attempts.
oncall-eng: I'm setting an autoscaler safety throttle: max-create-requests-per-minute=2 for asia-south2 to avoid exhausting control plane and reduce churn.
sre-lead: Good. Also create a temporary pool of preemptible smaller-gpu nodes that don't require the stuck quota class — will attempt spawn now.
ben: Attempting preemptible pool creation: `gcloud compute instances create ... --accelerator type=nvidia-t4,count=1 --preemptible` returns same quota error for T4. Trying alternate: `a2-highgpu-1g` (A100) — quota for that family is available but CV risk.
alice: A100s available but billing/ops note: cost spike and model perf differences; only use for critical routes if needed.
carol: Let's prioritize critical customer traffic to A100 pool if we must. Non-critical stays on CPU fallback.
oncall-eng: Update: preemptible A100 pool spun up (2 nodes), attached successfully, routed 5 critical pods. Error rate for critical routes reduced to ~1.2%.
support-bot: Noted customer impact improvement, sending update to customers.
sre-lead: Next actions: 1) escalate quota request with GCP via our account rep, mark P1 with attach errors + impact, 2) keep autoscaler throttle, 3) maintain routing/fallback until quota confirmed. Who owns the GCP escalation?
alice: I'll escalate and loop in @sre-lead and our account rep. Creating escalation ticket now.
ben: Logging post-incident snapshot to runbook: `/incidents/runbooks/attach-quota` updated with steps taken & timings.
carol: Recommend 30m post-mortem check-in to verify if quota increased and to analyze why autoscaler didn't detect quota-deny and stop creating.
oncall-eng: Agreed. Handoff to night oncall in 40m — I'll post summary then.
sre-lead: Handoff notes: throttled autoscaler in asia-south2, CPU fallback & job enqueue pause in place, critical traffic routed to A100 preemptibles and us-west2 warm pool for non-APAC. GCP quota escalation opened by @alice (ticket #GCP-78912). If quota not granted in 2h, escalate to cloud infra director.
oncall-eng: Leaving bridge, assigning to night-oncall. Will update thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Incident record created: INC-20260317-asia-south2-attach. Severity: Sev2. Customers alerted: top-10 APAC embeddings customers.
oncall-eng: Last check: pending pods steady at 4, 5xxs trending down. I'll hand off at 13:20 UTC.
sre-lead: Thanks team. Postmortem owner assigned to @ben. Please include timeline and config diffs.
ben: Acknowledged, will start drafting.
carol: Closing bridge — monitoring continues.
incidents-bot: Auto-note: incident channel archived after handoff.
